loss_stop_floor.alpha_selection_rule: §4.6 of F5-pin-request_r3: 0.10 if G1 passes; else smallest of {0.20,0.30} with G1 margin t_cross <= floor(0.8*T_low(e)); else unreachable_veto; never escalate on G3
loss_stop_floor.gate_rate_rule: r3 §4.5 D5 as amended by errata E-2: calibration rate_cal = take_rate_lower when pool > take_rate_lower, else max(pool, take_rate_lower); G1/G3 at min(pool, take_rate_lower); max(pool, take_rate_lower) calibration reported as a non-binding sensitivity row; takes->ticks via pool takes-per-station-day
loss_stop_floor.qty_rule: one StratumRow per unpaired (rung, side): entry_ask=ledger BE-bar, fee=0, qty=1 (§4.3)
loss_stop_floor.netting_rule: paired rung = one unit, delta_net = 1 - BEbar_y - BEbar_n, zero variance, enters x_d; zero-sigma days carry to next tick (§4.1 steps 2, 8)
loss_stop_floor.exit_rule: h_eff=(1-f)h+f*v, variance unexited; calibration margin = binding row S4
loss_stop_floor.bundle_null_rule: categorical_yes_first_shrink_v1 with errata E-1 residual outside mass m0 = prod(1-q) on all-YES overround days
loss_stop_floor.boundary_rule: FAIL iff S_t < -c*sqrt(t) for some t in [t_min, t_at_horizon]
loss_stop_floor.epoch_anchor_rule: latest autonomy TransitionRow for the FQ v2 family_id entering CHAMPION from a non-sender state with a non-empty policy_ruling_id; armed_at = ts_ns; refuse if absent
loss_stop_floor.epoch_id_rule: epoch_id = anchor transition_id; carried in latest.json and in the truth_sha preimage
loss_stop_floor.fail_latch_rule: fail_latch/<epoch_id>.json written O_EXCL+fsync before the first FAIL; checked before any input; never deleted; latch beats refusal
loss_stop_floor.refusal_rule: durable refusals/<as_of>.json (fsync file+dir), then unlink latest.json; on record-write failure unlink anyway and exit non-zero
loss_stop_floor.restart_rule: FAIL terminal within epoch; a new epoch needs a new qualifying arming row; S_t restarts at 0

inputs.sign_rule: r3 §4.1 step 1: the leg comes from the instrument; a NO buy is BUY on the NO-leg instrument at the NO price, and the wire price is never used.
inputs.fill_rule: r3 §4.1 steps 1 and 3: open lots are the instrument BUY fills after exits; one StratumRow per unpaired (rung, side) with qty 1.
inputs.fee_rule: r3 §4.1 step 3: entry_ask is the ledger BE-bar (cumulative cost + fee) / cumulative qty, StratumRow.fee is 0, and fee_reconciled false or a missing fee refuses.
inputs.void_rule: r3 §4.1 step 7: a voided leg contributes 0 to x_d and 0 to the variance.
inputs.truth_sha_rule: r3 §4.1 steps 5 and 8 produce the consumed records; §4.4.2 sets truth_sha to sha256 of the canonical JSON of epoch_id plus those C2 identities.
